name: smwgraphics-castlevania-iii-flying-skeleton
title: Castlevania III - Flying Skeleton
description:
The infamous gargoyle-like enemy that haunts Castlevania III players, now adapted to Super Mario World. Initially I ripped it and made some small edits to fit the Giant Eerie sprite, then, TheMorganah, decided to help me and thus, the sprite was redrawn.

It's main use is with the Giant Eerie sprite. But it can used for others 32 x 32 enemies, maybe.

Uses palette E.

Spooky Halloween for you all!
